answer_1.quote: Text style transfer is to transform an input text of a source style to a target style (i.e., style conversion goal) without loss of its style-independent information (i.e., content preservation goal).
answer_1.outputs: The dish is old and disgusting.

answer_2.quote: We measure the style compatibility by the prediction accuracy (ACC) of C eval on each model's output, using the target styles as ground-truth labels. For content preservation: ... We measure the content preservation by the BLEU score ... For fluency: ... We measure the fluency by the Perplexity (PPL) of LM on the model's outputs.

answer_4.quote: We invite three human annotators to evaluate different models' outputs for 200 test samples on each dataset. The annotators score each transfer result from 1 (the lowest quality) to 5 (the highest quality) in terms of style compatibility, content preservation, and fluency.
